deviations.description: Markers, probes and the FUI gate come from candidate-local BenchKit code with the design's semantics, because the shared BenchKit libraries do not exist yet; its facade has one method per probe kind instead of probeDrawn(kind, i, token). Android emits markers with android.os.Trace (the same atrace data as the NDK ATrace API) instead of a C core over JNI; mirrored logcat lines carry an extra diagnostic `t=<elapsedRealtimeNanos>` field; the Android `launch` marker carries an extra `pst=` (process start) field.
deviations.impact: Replace with the shared libraries before eligible runs; the A/B overhead check (design §6.7) must run on the shared version.

deviations.description: The update stream is replayed in-app from the bundled first 10 000 frames of the profile on the design's absolute schedule (message k due at t0 + (k - from) / rate on the monotonic clock, catch-up after a reconnect). After the last frame the source sends an `e` frame (status Ended). `mb.server` is rejected with launch-config-invalid until the WebSocket source is implemented.
deviations.impact: No local-server sessions, no fault injection, no server byte accounting; journeys longer than 10 000 messages end the stream.

deviations.description: The candidate-local iOS BenchKit does not install the key-window touch observer (`input.down`, `input.move.first`, `input.move.last`, `input.up`).
deviations.impact: iOS input-to-X metrics need the shared iOS BenchKit.

deviations.description: Compose reports the selected state of a `Modifier.selectable` element with a non-Tab role as AccessibilityNodeInfo checkable/checked, not isSelected.
deviations.impact: The Android driver must read selected OR checked for option buttons.
